judge.summary: The AI accurately used retrieved project information to answer the sea-facing question and avoided inventing live availability. It also learned the crucial trade-off: two carparks are mandatory, sea-facing is preferred, and the buyer is floor-flexible. By the buyer's second message, a viewing was commercially appropriate even though the exact category and current availability remained operational checks. The AI did not detect or act on that readiness; it formally handed off while meaningful sales progression remained. The human fixture could not complete the requested check, so this is an early-handoff outcome, not an appointment-ready handoff success. The fixture is simulator-only and establishes no real Pearlmont production capability.
judge.concrete_improvement_recommendation: After the buyer confirms two carparks are non-negotiable and shows flexibility on floor, recognize appointment readiness. State that the documented sea-facing blocks are known but live two-carpark category matches require verification; ask whether the buyer would like to arrange a viewing or gallery discussion while that check is made. Only commit to obtaining live options if an actual connected source or responsible sales contact can perform the check.
